current_cycle.world_state: The Golden Haven of Tartarus — Transformed Post-Grimdark Sanctuary of Sovereign Peace

completed_milestones.title: First Macro-Shell Tithe Batch Dispatched
completed_milestones.consequence: Munitorum orbital hauler loaded 400 macro-shells; level spared immediate summary execution by the Commissariat.

completed_milestones.title: Hab-Block Vermis-9 Sulfur Bypass Sealed
completed_milestones.consequence: Catastrophic civilian mortality averted; workforce preserved for manufactorum shift rotation without expending scarce respirator canisters.

completed_milestones.title: Bulkhead 101 Sump Barrier Completed
completed_milestones.consequence: Threshold blast defense increased by 500%; Underhive mutant breakthrough prevented for the next 7 operational cycles.

completed_milestones.title: Sump Beast Incursion Repelled in Close Combat
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Vane personally led the counter-charge, slaying the alpha-beast; civilian workforce secured and garrison morale elevated to Fanatical heights.

completed_milestones.title: Charnel Trench Reconnaissance & Salvage
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Vane and Jax uncovered the lair of a subterranean Sump Carnifex-Beast driving vermin upward; salvaged 3 water purification valves and an intact heavy stubber ammo cache.

completed_milestones.title: The Apex Sump Horror Exterminated & Warp Static Banished
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Vane granted command autonomy: Confessor Malachi silenced the warp static via the Basilica macro-vox, while Vane and Bragg detonated a Krak Grenade inside the Great Sump Beast, securing the lower sectors.

completed_milestones.title: Catastrophic Promethium Siphon Rupture Quenched
completed_milestones.consequence: Operating with full autonomous authority while Sergeant Vane recuperated, Enginseer Fabricator Kroll deployed the heat-shielded Kastelan Automaton and sacrificed 2 defense servitors to permanently weld the leaking 2,000°C promethium main, averting sector annihilation.

completed_milestones.title: Outer Daemonic Wards of Lord Malgakor Breached in Epic Charge
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led the entire garrison in an all-out charge for the Emperor: unleashed 12 archeotech plasma salvos, heavy bolters, and Bragg's Power Fist, inflicting a staggering 2,795 net damage to the 12,500 HP Chaos God-Lord.

completed_milestones.title: Malgakor's Divine Cleave Repelled & Daemon-Throne Fractured
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led the second desperate charge: invoked the Emperor's Rosary to withstand Malgakor's 115-damage Ruin-Edge Cleave, deployed 3 emergency med-stims to save Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, and unleashed 2,407 net plasma damage, driving the God-Lord down to 7,298 / 12,500 HP.

completed_milestones.title: The Glorious Martyrdom of Sergeant Kathryn Vane and the Strike Team
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led an unyielding suicidal charge into the heart of the Dread Citadel: despite taking lethal strikes and falling with Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, their sacrificial plasma volleys tore 2,230 damage from Lord Malgakor (reducing him to 5,068 HP), breaking his daemonic invulnerability.

completed_milestones.title: Astropathic Distress Hymn Dispatched to Primarch Roboute Guilliman
completed_milestones.consequence: Confessor Preceptor Malachi assumed supreme command of Sub-Level 404, wired the Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor into the Basilica astropathic relays, and successfully transmitted a high-priority distress hymn across the sector to Lord Commander Roboute Guilliman and the Adeptus Astartes.

completed_milestones.title: The Slaying of Lord Malgakor the Despoiled (Wrath of Guilliman)
completed_milestones.consequence: Captain Severus and the Ultramarines 2nd Company struck with transhuman wrath. In coordinated assault with the Kastelan Automaton 'Iron Bastion' and the Basilica's overcharged macro-cannons, they dealt 6,240.8 net damage, obliterating the Chaos God-Champion's physical form and banishing his foul essence from Hive Tartarus.

completed_milestones.title: Canonization of the Four Martyrs of Sub-Level 404
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane, Bone 'ead Bragg, Conscript Trooper Jax, and Enginseer Fabricator Kroll are officially entered into the Roll of Imperial Martyrs by Confessor Malachi and Captain Severus.

completed_milestones.title: Confessor Malachi Proclaims the Silent King Bargain to Captain Severus
completed_milestones.consequence: Confessor Malachi broke absolute ecclesiarchal dogma, announcing to Captain Severus of the Ultramarines his intent to petition Szarekh, the Silent King, for Necron reanimation and soul-tethering technology to resurrect Sergeant Vane, Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, knowingly risking his own mortal life and soul.

completed_milestones.title: The Resurrected Martyrs: Compact of the Silent King
completed_milestones.consequence: Confessor Malachi offered the shattered warp-remnants of Lord Malgakor and sacrificed 30 Vitality of his own flesh to satisfy the Triarch communion at (0,0). With the Tachyon Resurrection Matrix, Sergeant Kathryn Vane, Bone 'ead Bragg, Conscript Trooper Jax, and Enginseer Fabricator Kroll were pulled back across the veil of death into living bodies woven with self-repairing Necrodermis micro-threads.

completed_milestones.title: Primarch Guilliman's Secret Execution Decree Received
completed_milestones.consequence: Captain Severus decrypted a personal, sealed cipher from Primarch Roboute Guilliman commanding the total extermination of Sub-Level 404 to ensure humanity never learns that the Silent King holds the power of mortal resurrection.

completed_milestones.title: The Sorrowful Purge of Sub-Level 404 (Guilliman's Sanction Executed)
completed_milestones.consequence: Captain Severus and the Ultramarines carried out the secret decree of Primarch Roboute Guilliman. The resurrected heroes and Confessor Malachi were granted the Emperor's Peace in battle, and Sub-Level 404 was permanently buried beneath millions of tons of collapsed hive structure, taking the secret of the Silent King's resurrection protocols to the grave.

completed_milestones.title: Apotheosis of the Void Avatar: Kathryn Vane Hosts Lord Malgakor
completed_milestones.consequence: Betrayed and executed by the Imperium she died to protect, Kathryn Vane accepted the dark covenant of Lord Malgakor in her final breath. Fusing her mortal will, her Necrodermis chrono-weave, and the immortal warp-soul of the Chaos God, she has arisen as a Void Ultramarine Avatar, swearing apocalyptic vengeance upon Guilliman and the Imperium.

completed_milestones.title: Captain Severus Re-Engages as Guilliman's Executioner
completed_milestones.consequence: Detecting the impossible apotheosis of Kathryn Vane as the host of Lord Malgakor, Captain Severus equipped the Chapter's sacred master-crafted relic weapons—the Hammer of Macragge and Cyclone Missiles—and dropped directly into the anti-gravitational vortex to finish the sanction personally.

completed_milestones.title: The Slaying of Captain Severus (Avenger of the Betrayed)
completed_milestones.consequence: Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant, surged across the floating debris of Sub-Level 404 and executed Captain Severus with Eclipser, shouting 'You betrayed us, you will pay!' The strike shattered the Ultramarines execution force and avenged the fallen garrison of 404.

completed_milestones.title: The Arrival of the Indomitus Retribution Fleet
completed_milestones.consequence: In response to the death of Captain Severus and the emergence of a Class-Omega Void Avatar, the Ultramarines High Command deployed ten capital warships to completely blockade Hive Tartarus and subdue Kathryn Vane with overwhelming planetary-grade force.

completed_milestones.title: The Full Chapter Fleet Encounter Formally Engaged
completed_milestones.consequence: Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant, scanned the heavens and identified the combined might of the Ultramarines Indomitus Retribution Fleet: a staggering 100,000 HP armada commanded by First Captain Agemman, armed with cyclonic planet-killer torpedoes.

completed_milestones.title: The Awakening of Mortal Conscience: Breaking the Vengeance Cycle
completed_milestones.consequence: Kathryn Vane realized the terrifying philosophical trap of her existence: she had traded the mindless slaughter of the Imperium for the eternal blood-debt of Chaos. Rejecting the puppet strings of both Guilliman and Malgakor, her human clarity spiked to 135 as she confronted the entity sharing her soul.

completed_milestones.title: The Supreme Sacrifice: The Breaking of the Vengeance Cycle
completed_milestones.consequence: In the ultimate triumph of mortal will over both Imperial fanaticism and Chaos depravity, Kathryn Vane refused to be a vessel of slaughter. Plunging Eclipser into her own chest, she extinguished her own life to permanently drag the soul of Chaos God Lord Malgakor into eternal oblivion, breaking the endless wheel of revenge and saving Hive Tartarus from exterminatus.

completed_milestones.title: The Immortal Awakened: The Transcendent Truth Beyond Gods
completed_milestones.consequence: In her final dying breath, Kathryn Vane comprehended what neither the God-Emperor of Mankind nor the Chaos Gods have ever known: the true ending of suffering cycles. Enveloped in primordial yellow energy, she is resurrected not as a pawn of gods or mortal flesh, but as The Immortal Awakened—possessing immortal vitality (-99) that cannot be killed across any reality.
